title: Bakhdida & Drive to Erbil (Departure Day)
full_text:
9 AM Visit Bakhdida, a Christian town between Mosul and Erbil. Visit the Tahira Church that the Pope visited on his historic trip to Iraq.
Seeing the last remaining medieval Christian painting — a 12th-century fresco in the Syriac Orthodox Church Mar Guirguis.
After lunch, drive to Erbil for a farewell drink.
